items.title: 中國央行7月增持約20噸黃金儲備 已是「21連增」
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Increases Gold Reserves by About 20 Tons in July, Marking 21 Consecutive Months of Gains
paras: 根據中國國家外匯管理局與人民銀行最新披露，截至 2026 年 7 月末，中國黃金儲備已連續第 21 個月增持。
數據顯示，中國 7 月末黃金儲備量由 6 月末的 7,544 萬盎司上升至 7,608 萬盎司。7 月單月增持規模達 64 萬盎司 (約 20 噸)，這不僅延續了自 2022 年以來的增長趨勢，更是自 2023 年 10 月以來最大的單月增持量。截至 7 月底，中國黃金儲備的帳面價值已升至 3,063.5 億美元。
各國央行對黃金的青睞，源於對沖地緣政治風險與儲備多元化的需求。世界黃金協會指出，全球央行在 2026 年第二季的購金需求強勁反彈，達 289 噸。此外，中國央行近期積極在香港建立黃金庫存，支持其發展為黃金交易中心，並逐步將原本存放於倫敦的儲備運回國內。
在中國人民銀行數據公布後，現貨黃金價格上漲 1.8%，突破每盎司 4,316 美元，創下 6 月中旬以來的最高價格。
此前，隨着美國通膨數據放緩，市場對聯準會升息的預期有所降溫，黃金價格在 7 月結束了連續四個月的跌勢，單月上漲約 0.84%。
專家預計，儘管短期內各國央行可能根據金價波動戰術性調整買入節奏，但實現儲備多元化仍將是長期戰略重心。
paras_en: According to the latest disclosures from China’s State Administration of Foreign Exchange and the People’s Bank of China, China’s gold reserves have increased for the 21st consecutive month as of the end of July 2026.

Data show that China’s gold reserve holdings rose from 75.44 million ounces at the end of June to 76.08 million ounces at the end of July, a monthly increase of 640,000 ounces (about 20 tonnes). This not only continues the upward trend that began in 2022 but also represents the largest single‑month addition since October 2023. By the end of July, the book value of China’s gold reserves had risen to $306.35 billion.

Central banks worldwide favor gold as a hedge against geopolitical risk and a means to diversify reserves. The World Gold Council noted a strong rebound in central‑bank gold purchases in Q2 2026, reaching 289 tonnes. In addition, the People’s Bank of China has recently been actively building gold inventories in Hong Kong to support its development as a gold trading hub and is gradually moving reserves previously stored in London back to the mainland.
Following the release of the People’s Bank of China data, spot gold prices jumped 1.8%, breaking above $4,316 per ounce, the highest level since mid‑June.
Earlier, as U.S. inflation data eased, market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes cooled, and gold prices ended a four‑month decline in July, rising about 0.84% for the month.
Experts expect that although central banks may tactically adjust their buying pace in the short term in response to price movements, diversifying reserves will remain a long‑term strategic focus.

items.title: 台灣櫻花上半年淨利成長7% 每股純益3.26元
items.title_en: Taiwan Cherry Blossom Reports 7% Net Profit Growth in First Half of 2026
paras: 廚衛電供應商台灣櫻花 (9911-TW) 今 (7) 日公布最新財報獲利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後純益爲 3.04 億元，季減 25.52%，年增 6.54%，每股純益 1.39 元；2026 年上半年稅後純益 7.13 億元，年增 6.98%。每股純益 3.26 元。
台灣櫻花 2026 年第二季營收 25.86 億元，毛利率 35.18%，季減 0.48 個百分點，年增 0.14 個百分點，026 年第二季稅後純益爲 3.04 億元，季減 25.52%，年增 6.54%，每股純益 1.39 元。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年營收 54.97 億元，毛利率 35.43%，年增 0.63 個百分點，2026 年上半年稅後純益 7.13 億元，年增 6.98%。每股純益 3.26 元。
台灣櫻花指出，2026 年上半年受惠既有家庭換購需求穩定，AI KITCHEN 持續帶動廚衛電產品升級，以及整體家居業務持續擴展。隨高階智能產品銷售占比提升及營運規模擴大，營業利益增幅高於營收增幅，顯示營運結構持續優化。
廚衛電事業受惠於穩定換購需求，以及經銷通路持續深化智能與高階產品銷售，成為上半年營收成長的主要動能。台灣櫻花憑藉長期累積的品牌信任、通路覆蓋及售後服務能力，持續掌握產品汰舊換新與居家設備升級需求；同時深化 AI KITCHEN 布局，透過環境感測、未來預判、智慧調節功能，提升產品使用體驗，將換購需求進一步轉化為產品升級動能。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年 AI 產品銷售額較去年同期成長 16%，顯示智慧廚房應用逐步獲得市場認同，並帶動高階產品銷售占比提升，推升廚衛電事業上半年營收年增 5%。淨水產品方面，受惠於淨水設備銷售帶動，濾心較去年同期成長 19%，延續成長動能。透過淨水產品設備銷售、定期濾心更換的長尾收入與售後服務，進一步深化既有家庭用戶的持續經營。
台灣櫻花在整體家居事業隨著建案交屋進度推進，出貨量持續提升，上半年營收較去年同期成長 7%。建案市場方面，公司持續發揮整體廚房規劃、供應及大規模交付能力，承接建商整體規劃需求；零售市場則透過生活館通路與顧問式服務，提供消費者更完整的產品體驗。AI KITCHEN 於建案及零售市場的簽約滲透率皆已達到 20% 以上，持續帶動智慧廚房與產品升級需求，並提升整體廚房的產品組合與客戶價值。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年整體廚房與全屋裝修新增簽約量合計較去年同期成長 16%，反映建商客戶需求及公司接案動能穩健提升。由於建案簽約將隨後續工程、交屋及安裝進度，逐步轉化為產品出貨與營收，持續成長的簽約量亦為未來營收提供良好能見度。

台灣櫻花表示，隨消費者需求由單一產品選購，逐步延伸至整體居家空間的規劃與服務，公司持續深化「HOME in O.N.E」發展策略，串聯廚衛電、整體廚房及全屋裝修資源，提供涵蓋產品、設計、施工及售後服務的一站式居家解決方案。透過既有品牌、通路及客戶基礎，台灣櫻花正由單品供應商進一步轉型為美好居家生活的創造者，對單一家庭的服務範圍由單一設備延伸至完整空間及不同生活階段的居家需求，單戶服務價值具備由單品級距躍升到整體空間方案級距、達數十倍擴張的潛力，並同步深化客戶關係與長期價值。
展望下半年，台灣櫻花廚衛電事業可望受惠於穩定換購需求與居家設備升級，並透過加速 AI Kitchen 智能產品導入，帶動高階產品銷售占比提升，進一步優化產品組合。整體家居事業方面，隨既有建案陸續進入交屋及安裝階段，專案出貨動能有望延續；零售市場則藉由生活館通路及顧問式服務，拓展客戶觸及與服務範圍。在核心事業穩健發展、成長型業務貢獻逐步提升下，公司預期全年營運將維持正向成長。
paras_en: Taiwan Cherry Blossom (9911-TW) announced its latest financial report on July 7, 2026, with a net profit of NT$304 million in the second quarter of 2026, down 25.52% from the previous quarter and up 6.54% from the same period last year. The company's net profit per share was NT$1.39.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's revenue in the second quarter of 2026 was NT$25.86 billion, with a gross margin of 35.18%, down 0.48 percentage points from the previous quarter and up 0.14 percentage points from the same period last year.

The company's revenue in the first half of 2026 was NT$54.97 billion, with a gross margin of 35.43%, up 0.63 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit in the first half of 2026 was NT$713 million, up 6.98% from the same period last year.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom attributed its growth in the first half of 2026 to stable demand for household replacements, the continued driving force of AI KITCHEN in upgrading kitchen electrical products, and the continued expansion of its home business.

The company's kitchen electrical business benefited from stable replacement demand and the continued deepening of sales channels for intelligent and high-end products, becoming the main driving force for revenue growth in the first half of 2026.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom has maintained its brand trust, sales channels, and after-sales service capabilities through long-term accumulation, allowing it to continue to grasp the demand for product replacement and home equipment upgrades. At the same time, it has deepened the layout of AI KITCHEN, using environmental sensing, future prediction, and intelligent adjustment functions to enhance product usage experience and further convert replacement demand into product upgrade momentum.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's AI product sales in the first half of 2026 grew 16% year-over-year, indicating that intelligent kitchen applications are gradually gaining market recognition and driving the growth of high-end product sales. The company's water purification products also benefited from the sales of water purification equipment, with filter sales growing 19% year-over-year.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's home business continued to grow, with revenue up 7% year-over-year in the first half of 2026. The company's home business benefited from the continued growth of its home business and the expansion of its sales channels.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom has continued to develop its "HOME in O.N.E" development strategy, integrating its kitchen electrical, whole kitchen, and whole home renovation resources to provide a one-stop home solution covering products, design, construction, and after-sales services.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Taiwan Cherry Blossom's kitchen electrical business is expected to benefit from stable replacement demand and home equipment upgrades, while its home business is expected to benefit from the continued growth of its home business and the expansion of its sales channels.

items.title: 佳能上半年淨利達5.11億元年增1.51倍 EPS1.55元
items.title_en: Canon Reports 5.11 Billion Net Profit for First Half of 2026, EPS 1.55 Yuan
paras: 佳能企業 (2374-TW) 今 (7) 日公布最新獲利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後純益 2.75 億元，季增 16.43%，年增 1.37 倍，單季每股純益 0.82 元；2026 年 上半年稅後純益 5.11 億元，年增 1.51 倍，每股純益達 1.55 元。
佳能 2026 年第二季營收 31.36 億元，毛利率 24.07%，季減 0.25 個百分點，年減 4.06 個百分點，單季稅後純益 2.75 億元，季增 16.43%，年增 1.37 倍，單季每股純益 0.82 元。
佳能 2026 年上半年營收 57.92 億元，毛利率爲 24.18%，年減 4.41 個百分點，2026 年 上半年稅後純益 5.11 億元，年增 1.51 倍，每股純益達 1.55 元。

佳能指出，近期也積極深化 AI 策略合作，轉投資「佳捷智能」，將結合鑫蘊林科（Linker Vision）在 AI 視覺辨識、生成式 AI 及城市級 AI 監控平台的技術能力，並透過輝達 (NVDA-US) NVIDIA AI 生態系與 Metropolis 平台所建立的高效能 AI 推論架構，將可望形成「高階光學影像＋AI 視覺分析＋邊緣運算＋城市管理平台」的一站式智慧城市解決方案，不僅有助提升大型政府標案與企業專案競爭力，也將進一步提高產品附加價值。
佳能指出，從智慧城市到智慧工廠，再延伸至人形機器人及服務型機器人，AI 視覺將是未來數兆美元市場的重要核心技術。佳能近年除持續布局 AI 智慧城市外，亦透過集團投資策略，佳能關注包括 Mantis Robotics、Agility Robotics 及日系人形機器人等機器人新創發展趨勢，未來結合集團在光學、AI 演算法、視覺感測及智慧製造資源，可望掌握下一波 AI 機器人產業成長契機。
展望下半年，隨著全球 AI 運算需求持續提升、智慧城市建設加速推進，以及機器人產業正式邁入商業化階段，佳能將持續受惠於 AI 影像應用滲透率提升、高階產品比重增加及策略合作效益逐步發酵，為未來營運與獲利帶來新的成長動能。
paras_en: Canon Inc. (2374-TW) announced its latest earnings information today, with a net profit of 2.75 billion yuan in the second quarter of 2026, up 16.43% from the previous quarter and 1.37 times the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was 5.11 billion yuan, up 1.51 times from the same period last year, with an EPS of 1.55 yuan.

Canon's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was 31.36 billion yuan, with a gross margin of 24.07%, down 0.25 percentage points from the previous quarter and 4.06 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the second quarter of 2026 was 2.75 billion yuan, up 16.43% from the previous quarter and 1.37 times the same period last year.

Canon's revenue for the first half of 2026 was 57.92 billion yuan, with a gross margin of 24.18%, down 4.41 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was 5.11 billion yuan, up 1.51 times from the same period last year, with an EPS of 1.55 yuan.

Canon noted that it has been actively deepening its AI strategy cooperation in recent times, investing in 'Canon Smart' and combining the technology capabilities of Linker Vision in AI visual recognition, generative AI, and city-level AI monitoring platforms. Through the NVIDIA AI ecosystem and Metropolis platform established by NVIDIA (NVDA-US), the company aims to form a one-stop intelligent city solution that integrates high-level optical imaging, AI visual analysis, edge computing, and city management platforms, which will not only enhance the company's competitiveness in large government contracts and enterprise projects but also increase product added value.

Canon noted that AI vision will be a key core technology in the future trillion-dollar market, from intelligent cities to intelligent factories, and extending to humanoid robots and service robots. In addition to continuously laying out AI intelligent cities, Canon has also invested in robot startups through its group investment strategy, focusing on Mantis Robotics, Agility Robotics, and Japanese humanoid robots, and aims to seize the next wave of AI robot industry growth opportunities by combining the group's resources in optics, AI algorithms, visual sensing, and intelligent manufacturing.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, with the global AI computing demand continuing to rise, intelligent city construction accelerating, and the robot industry formally entering the commercialization stage, Canon will continue to benefit from the increasing penetration rate of AI image applications, higher-end product ratios, and strategic cooperation benefits, bringing new growth momentum to future operations and profits.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉四寶7月營收年月雙增同樂  南亞受惠AI貢獻創49個月來新高
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Group's Four Major Businesses Achieve Double-Digit Growth in July
paras: 台塑 (1301-TW) 集團四寶今 (7) 日公告 7 月營收及未來展望，受惠美伊地緣衝突帶動油價及石化原料上揚，加上旺季支援，營收均呈現年月雙增，南亞 (1303-TW)、台化 (1326-TW)、台塑化 (6505-TW) 年增更超過 3 成以上。南亞更因北美雲端業者 (CSP) 全力打造資料中心，售價調漲挹注，營收創近 49 個月以來新高。
台塑 7 月營收為 152.94 億元、月增 9.4％、年增 4.8％，今 (2026) 年前 7 月累計營收為 1,045.33 億元、年減 2.5%。台塑表示，7 月因乙烯供應量比 6 月增加，加上開工率提高，及美伊衝突再起，下游客戶預期石化產品價格上漲，購買意願回升，主要產品銷量較 6 月增加 7.8 萬噸。
南亞 7 月營收為 305.73 億元、月增 12.7％、年增更達 44.5％，前 7 月累計營收為 1,828.16 億元、年增 19.9％。
南亞在四大產業成長貢獻之下，單月營收攀升至 49 個月新高，在電子材料產品的核心動能推升下，營收占比再提升至 57%，隨北美 CSP 業者全力打造資料中心，擴充伺服器，再加上中系業者也積極佈署算力建設，使相關材料供需缺口再放大，南亞依市況調漲電子材料售價、提高產能利用率至 9 成以上，讓營收貢獻提高。
此外，南亞的消費性泛用材料的業績也持續成長，化工產品因 EG、BPA 下游補庫存，塑膠產品則因車用、鞋材需求回溫，銷量及營收增加。
台化 7 月營收 312.67 億元、月增 13％、年增 34.2％，前 7 月累計 2,001.71 億元、年增 13.9％。台化表示，受地緣政治等因素影響，市況起伏不定，故加強銷售及去化庫存，包括 PX、SM、PS、ABS、PP 增加銷售，PTA、PIA 下游客戶需求提升。售價方面，台化因油價及石化原料上漲，墊高產品行情，也調整產品組合，提高差異化產品比例，拉升平均售價。

台塑化 7 月營收 748.21 億元、月增 17.5%、年增 31.5%，9,073.13 億元、年增 11.9％。台塑化指出，因原油陸續交貨，產品總銷售量比 6 月增加 1414 千桶，隨著美伊和談重啟，國際油價逐步走跌，7 月杜拜原油均價 76.7 美元 / 桶，比上月下跌 2.8 美元 / 桶，但中東成品油供給仍持續緊張，且東北亞煉廠出口趨於保守，推升成品油的現貨價格。致全產品均售價反而比 6 月增加 1.5 美元 / 桶。
台塑化烯烴事業營業額則比 6 月增加 29.7%，主因為乙烯產品售量增加，且售電價與售電量均月增，也帶動公用事業營業額比上月增加 15％。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Group (1301-TW) announced its July revenue and future outlook on July 7, benefiting from the surge in oil prices and petrochemical raw materials due to the US-Iran geopolitical tensions, as well as the peak season support, with revenue showing year-over-year and month-over-month growth. South Asia (1303-TW), Formosa Petrochemical (6505-TW), and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (1326-TW) saw year-over-year growth exceeding 3%.

Formosa Plastics' July revenue reached NT$152.94 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 9.4% and a year-over-year increase of 4.8%. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$1,045.33 billion, down 2.5% year-over-year. Formosa Plastics stated that July's revenue was boosted by an increase in ethylene supply, higher production rates, and the resurgence of US-Iran tensions, leading to increased demand for petrochemical products and higher prices.

South Asia's July revenue reached NT$305.73 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 12.7% and a year-over-year increase of 44.5%. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$1,828.16 billion, up 19.9% year-over-year.

South Asia's revenue growth was driven by the four major industries, with single-month revenue reaching a new high of 49 months. The company's revenue share from electronic materials products increased to 57%, driven by the core driving force of electronic materials products. The company also benefited from the expansion of data centers by North American CSP companies, which increased demand for related materials, leading to a shortage and higher prices. South Asia adjusted its electronic materials prices and increased its production capacity utilization rate to over 90%, contributing to revenue growth.

In addition, South Asia's consumer-grade general-purpose materials continued to grow, with chemical products benefiting from the replenishment of inventory for EG and BPA, and plastic products benefiting from the recovery of demand for automotive and footwear materials, leading to increased sales and revenue.

Formosa Chemicals & Fibre's July revenue reached NT$312.67 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 13% and a year-over-year increase of 34.2%. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$2,001.71 billion, up 13.9% year-over-year. Formosa Chemicals & Fibre stated that it strengthened sales and reduced inventory due to the impact of geopolitical factors, including the increase in sales of PX, SM, PS, ABS, and PP, as well as the increase in demand from downstream customers for PTA and PIA. The company also adjusted its product mix to increase the proportion of differentiated products and raise average prices.

Formosa Plastics Petrochemical's July revenue reached NT$748.21 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 17.5% and a year-over-year increase of 31.5%. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of 2026 was NT$9,073.13 billion, up 11.9% year-over-year. Formosa Plastics Petrochemical stated that the delivery of crude oil led to an increase in total sales volume of 1,414,000 barrels compared to June, and the reactivation of US-Iran talks led to a gradual decline in international oil prices, with the Dubai crude oil price averaging $76.7 per barrel in July, down $2.8 per barrel from the previous month. However, the supply of refined oil products in the Middle East remained tight, and the export of refined oil products from Northeast Asian refineries became conservative, leading to higher spot prices for refined oil products. As a result, the average selling price of all products increased by $1.5 per barrel compared to June.

items.title_en: Compal’s Revenue for First Seven Months Reaches NT$520.6 B, Up Over 10% YoY; Q3 Growth Driven by Servers
paras: 仁寶 (2324-TW) 今 (7) 日公告 7 月營收 810.06 億元，年增逾 4 成，累計今年前 7 月營收 5206.04 億元，年增逾 1 成。仁寶管理層表示，第三季主要成長動能來自伺服器，不過詳細展望將於下周四 (13 日) 法說會釋出。

仁寶積極布局伺服器業務，先前斥資 40 億元投資的台灣桃園大溪廠，將於下周二 (11 日) 啟用，該廠聚焦高階伺服器產品，有 SMT 與組裝完整產線，並設置 Server Lab。此外，也將於下周四召開法說會並公布財報，預料屆時將釋出伺服器業務的最新進展。
paras_en: Compal (2324‑TW) today (the 7th) announced July revenue of NT$81.006 billion, up more than 40% year‑over‑year, bringing cumulative revenue for the first seven months of this year to NT$520.604 billion, up more than 10% year‑over‑year. Management said the main growth driver for Q3 will be servers, but detailed outlook will be released at the earnings conference next Thursday (the 13th).

July revenue was NT$81.006 billion, down 15.49% month‑over‑month but up 38.26% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for Jan‑July was NT$520.604 billion, up 18.82% year‑over‑year. Regarding PC shipments in July, management said July PC shipments were 1.8 million units, down 25% month‑over‑month and down 21.74% year‑over‑year.

Compal is actively expanding its server business. The Taiwan Taoyuan Daxi plant, in which it previously invested NT$4.0 billion, will commence operations next Tuesday (the 11th). The plant focuses on high‑end server products, has a complete SMT and assembly production line, and includes a Server Lab. In addition, an earnings conference will be held next Thursday where the financial results will be released, and the latest developments in the server business are expected to be disclosed.

items.title: 網通機會別錯過！中磊(5388)營收再創新高，這波能走多久？
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 從 2022 年到 2026 年第 1 季，美國 Cable broadband 用戶從約 8,232 萬戶降至 7,902 萬戶，市占率也從約 67% 降至 56.8%；同期固定無線寬頻 FWA 用戶則由約 396 萬戶增加至 2,040 萬戶，市占率一路升至 14.7%。
衛星寬頻的成長速度更快，2026 年第 1 季年增率達 48.2%。
而 SpaceX 更進一步表態，未來不只要做偏遠地區寬頻，也計畫在 2027 年推出 Starlink Mobile，將服務延伸到行動通訊。
低軌衛星加入，加上 FWA 快速成長，讓美國寬頻市場的競爭進一步升溫，設備需求隨之增加。
中磊 2026 年第 2 季營收達 206.1 億元，創歷史新高，北美電信商的光纖設備與 5G FWA 已經開始大量出貨，DOCSIS 4.0、10G PON 與 Wi-Fi 7 也同步進入升級週期。
（資料來源：優分析產業數據中心）
接下來值得關注的問題是，這一波升級規模有多大？現在進展到什麼階段？

前所未有的光纖投資浪潮
AT&T 的光纖擴張目標最明確，計畫到 2029 年讓光纖經過地點超過 5,000 萬個，其中約 4,500 萬個自行建設、500 萬個來自與 BlackRock 合資的 Gigapower。
2025 年底公司光纖網路已經經過超過 3,000 萬個地點，目前大約完成六成，距離目標仍有接近 2,000 萬個地點的建設空間。
Verizon 則是透過大型併購快速擴大版圖，2026 年初完成約 200 億美元收購 Frontier，合併後固網版圖擴大至約 31 州、3,000 萬戶家庭。
接下來再透過 Eaton Fiber 等合作向既有覆蓋區外延伸，規劃未來幾年新增超過 100 萬個光纖服務地點；2026 年第 2 季，Verizon 單季再增加約 15.5 萬個光纖寬頻用戶，顯示收購完成後已進入持續擴建與增加用戶的階段。
T-Mobile 截至 2026 年 3 月，公司 FWA 用戶已接近 880 萬戶；光纖方面，與 KKR 合作的 Metronet 目前已經過約 220 萬戶家庭，目標到 2030 年底擴大至 650 萬個地點。
未來仍有超過 400 萬個地點的建設空間，另外也透過 Lumos 持續增加光纖覆蓋。

光纖要建，5G 網路也不能停
當光纖可以提供更高速度後，為了維持競爭力，兩大 Cable 龍頭業者都在積極投入新一代規格升級。
Comcast 已經開始大量部署 DOCSIS 4.0，截至 2026 年 3 月，相關服務已經覆蓋數百萬戶家庭；Charter 則採取分階段升級，先把現有 DOCSIS 3.1 網路提高容量，再逐步導入 DAA 與 DOCSIS 4.0。
Vistance 是 DOCSIS 4.0 升級的關鍵設備供應商，2026 年第 2 季，新一代 DOCSIS 4.0 產品已占其 Aurora 業務約 70%營收。公司表示目前仍處於升級週期的早期階段並將持續數年。
再加上 FWA 的快速成長，截至 2026 年第 1 季，美國 FWA 用戶已經達到約 2,040 萬戶，相較 2022 年第 1 季約 396 萬戶，四年間增加超過 4 倍。

FWA 全名是 Fixed Wireless Access，也就是利用 5G 行動網路提供家庭寬頻。使用者不一定需要等光纖拉到家裡，只要裝一台接收 5G 訊號的設備，就可以使用家庭網路。
最大受惠者：中磊(5388-TW)
中磊約 70% 營收來自北美，而訂單能見度也持續往後延伸：今年 3 月時主要看到 2026 年底，6 月開始洽談 1H27 訂單並提前準備記憶體，到了 7 月，訂單能見度已看到 2Q27。
而其優勢在於，Cable 升級 DOCSIS 4.0，中磊有產品；電信商擴建光纖與 10G PON，中磊有產品；行動電信商利用 5G FWA 發展家庭寬頻，中磊也有產品。
不過，設備出很多，CPE 本身卻不是高毛利產品，再加上記憶體成本上升，所以今年營收快速成長，毛利率仍大約只有 13%。
年初記憶體漲價時，公司還需要自行吸收部分成本；現在則已逐步將成本反映到產品報價，代表原本壓抑獲利的因素開始出現轉變。接下來的問題，是這些訂單最後能留下多少獲利。
（資料來源：優分析產業數據中心）
整體來看，美國寬頻市場已進入光纖、Cable、FWA與衛星同時加速的競爭期。AT&T的光纖計畫看到2029年，T-Mobile的光纖布局看到2030年，DOCSIS 4.0也才剛進入早期部署。
接下來需要關注的，是記憶體供應能否跟上、DAA 能不能在 2027 年如期放量，以及營收規模擴大後，費用率下降能否推升營益率。持續追蹤這些潛在變數與市場動態，才能更全面地評估公司長期發展潛力。

items.title: 台灣櫻花上半年淨利成長7% 每股純益3.26元
items.title_en: Taiwan Cherry Blossom Reports 7% Net Profit Growth in First Half of 2026
paras: 廚衛電供應商台灣櫻花 (9911-TW) 今 (7) 日公布最新財報獲利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後純益爲 3.04 億元，季減 25.52%，年增 6.54%，每股純益 1.39 元；2026 年上半年稅後純益 7.13 億元，年增 6.98%。每股純益 3.26 元。
台灣櫻花 2026 年第二季營收 25.86 億元，毛利率 35.18%，季減 0.48 個百分點，年增 0.14 個百分點，026 年第二季稅後純益爲 3.04 億元，季減 25.52%，年增 6.54%，每股純益 1.39 元。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年營收 54.97 億元，毛利率 35.43%，年增 0.63 個百分點，2026 年上半年稅後純益 7.13 億元，年增 6.98%。每股純益 3.26 元。
台灣櫻花指出，2026 年上半年受惠既有家庭換購需求穩定，AI KITCHEN 持續帶動廚衛電產品升級，以及整體家居業務持續擴展。隨高階智能產品銷售占比提升及營運規模擴大，營業利益增幅高於營收增幅，顯示營運結構持續優化。
廚衛電事業受惠於穩定換購需求，以及經銷通路持續深化智能與高階產品銷售，成為上半年營收成長的主要動能。台灣櫻花憑藉長期累積的品牌信任、通路覆蓋及售後服務能力，持續掌握產品汰舊換新與居家設備升級需求；同時深化 AI KITCHEN 布局，透過環境感測、未來預判、智慧調節功能，提升產品使用體驗，將換購需求進一步轉化為產品升級動能。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年 AI 產品銷售額較去年同期成長 16%，顯示智慧廚房應用逐步獲得市場認同，並帶動高階產品銷售占比提升，推升廚衛電事業上半年營收年增 5%。淨水產品方面，受惠於淨水設備銷售帶動，濾心較去年同期成長 19%，延續成長動能。透過淨水產品設備銷售、定期濾心更換的長尾收入與售後服務，進一步深化既有家庭用戶的持續經營。
台灣櫻花在整體家居事業隨著建案交屋進度推進，出貨量持續提升，上半年營收較去年同期成長 7%。建案市場方面，公司持續發揮整體廚房規劃、供應及大規模交付能力，承接建商整體規劃需求；零售市場則透過生活館通路與顧問式服務，提供消費者更完整的產品體驗。AI KITCHEN 於建案及零售市場的簽約滲透率皆已達到 20% 以上，持續帶動智慧廚房與產品升級需求，並提升整體廚房的產品組合與客戶價值。
台灣櫻花 2026 年上半年整體廚房與全屋裝修新增簽約量合計較去年同期成長 16%，反映建商客戶需求及公司接案動能穩健提升。由於建案簽約將隨後續工程、交屋及安裝進度，逐步轉化為產品出貨與營收，持續成長的簽約量亦為未來營收提供良好能見度。

台灣櫻花表示，隨消費者需求由單一產品選購，逐步延伸至整體居家空間的規劃與服務，公司持續深化「HOME in O.N.E」發展策略，串聯廚衛電、整體廚房及全屋裝修資源，提供涵蓋產品、設計、施工及售後服務的一站式居家解決方案。透過既有品牌、通路及客戶基礎，台灣櫻花正由單品供應商進一步轉型為美好居家生活的創造者，對單一家庭的服務範圍由單一設備延伸至完整空間及不同生活階段的居家需求，單戶服務價值具備由單品級距躍升到整體空間方案級距、達數十倍擴張的潛力，並同步深化客戶關係與長期價值。
展望下半年，台灣櫻花廚衛電事業可望受惠於穩定換購需求與居家設備升級，並透過加速 AI Kitchen 智能產品導入，帶動高階產品銷售占比提升，進一步優化產品組合。整體家居事業方面，隨既有建案陸續進入交屋及安裝階段，專案出貨動能有望延續；零售市場則藉由生活館通路及顧問式服務，拓展客戶觸及與服務範圍。在核心事業穩健發展、成長型業務貢獻逐步提升下，公司預期全年營運將維持正向成長。
paras_en: Taiwan Cherry Blossom (9911-TW) announced its latest financial report on July 7, 2026, with a net profit of NT$304 million in the second quarter of 2026, down 25.52% from the previous quarter and up 6.54% from the same period last year. The company's net profit per share was NT$1.39.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's revenue in the second quarter of 2026 was NT$25.86 billion, with a gross margin of 35.18%, down 0.48 percentage points from the previous quarter and up 0.14 percentage points from the same period last year.

The company's revenue in the first half of 2026 was NT$54.97 billion, with a gross margin of 35.43%, up 0.63 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit in the first half of 2026 was NT$713 million, up 6.98% from the same period last year.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom attributed its growth in the first half of 2026 to stable demand for household replacements, the continued driving force of AI KITCHEN in upgrading kitchen electrical products, and the continued expansion of its home business.

The company's kitchen electrical business benefited from stable replacement demand and the continued deepening of sales channels for intelligent and high-end products, becoming the main driving force for revenue growth in the first half of 2026.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom has maintained its brand trust, sales channels, and after-sales service capabilities through long-term accumulation, allowing it to continue to grasp the demand for product replacement and home equipment upgrades. At the same time, it has deepened the layout of AI KITCHEN, using environmental sensing, future prediction, and intelligent adjustment functions to enhance product usage experience and further convert replacement demand into product upgrade momentum.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's AI product sales in the first half of 2026 grew 16% year-over-year, indicating that intelligent kitchen applications are gradually gaining market recognition and driving the growth of high-end product sales. The company's water purification products also benefited from the sales of water purification equipment, with filter sales growing 19% year-over-year.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom's home business continued to grow, with revenue up 7% year-over-year in the first half of 2026. The company's home business benefited from the continued growth of its home business and the expansion of its sales channels.

Taiwan Cherry Blossom has continued to develop its "HOME in O.N.E" development strategy, integrating its kitchen electrical, whole kitchen, and whole home renovation resources to provide a one-stop home solution covering products, design, construction, and after-sales services.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Taiwan Cherry Blossom's kitchen electrical business is expected to benefit from stable replacement demand and home equipment upgrades, while its home business is expected to benefit from the continued growth of its home business and the expansion of its sales channels.

items.title: 佳能上半年淨利達5.11億元年增1.51倍 EPS1.55元
items.title_en: Canon Reports 5.11 Billion Net Profit for First Half of 2026, EPS 1.55 Yuan
paras: 佳能企業 (2374-TW) 今 (7) 日公布最新獲利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後純益 2.75 億元，季增 16.43%，年增 1.37 倍，單季每股純益 0.82 元；2026 年 上半年稅後純益 5.11 億元，年增 1.51 倍，每股純益達 1.55 元。
佳能 2026 年第二季營收 31.36 億元，毛利率 24.07%，季減 0.25 個百分點，年減 4.06 個百分點，單季稅後純益 2.75 億元，季增 16.43%，年增 1.37 倍，單季每股純益 0.82 元。
佳能 2026 年上半年營收 57.92 億元，毛利率爲 24.18%，年減 4.41 個百分點，2026 年 上半年稅後純益 5.11 億元，年增 1.51 倍，每股純益達 1.55 元。

佳能指出，近期也積極深化 AI 策略合作，轉投資「佳捷智能」，將結合鑫蘊林科（Linker Vision）在 AI 視覺辨識、生成式 AI 及城市級 AI 監控平台的技術能力，並透過輝達 (NVDA-US) NVIDIA AI 生態系與 Metropolis 平台所建立的高效能 AI 推論架構，將可望形成「高階光學影像＋AI 視覺分析＋邊緣運算＋城市管理平台」的一站式智慧城市解決方案，不僅有助提升大型政府標案與企業專案競爭力，也將進一步提高產品附加價值。
佳能指出，從智慧城市到智慧工廠，再延伸至人形機器人及服務型機器人，AI 視覺將是未來數兆美元市場的重要核心技術。佳能近年除持續布局 AI 智慧城市外，亦透過集團投資策略，佳能關注包括 Mantis Robotics、Agility Robotics 及日系人形機器人等機器人新創發展趨勢，未來結合集團在光學、AI 演算法、視覺感測及智慧製造資源，可望掌握下一波 AI 機器人產業成長契機。
展望下半年，隨著全球 AI 運算需求持續提升、智慧城市建設加速推進，以及機器人產業正式邁入商業化階段，佳能將持續受惠於 AI 影像應用滲透率提升、高階產品比重增加及策略合作效益逐步發酵，為未來營運與獲利帶來新的成長動能。
paras_en: Canon Inc. (2374-TW) announced its latest earnings information today, with a net profit of 2.75 billion yuan in the second quarter of 2026, up 16.43% from the previous quarter and 1.37 times the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was 5.11 billion yuan, up 1.51 times from the same period last year, with an EPS of 1.55 yuan.

Canon's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was 31.36 billion yuan, with a gross margin of 24.07%, down 0.25 percentage points from the previous quarter and 4.06 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the second quarter of 2026 was 2.75 billion yuan, up 16.43% from the previous quarter and 1.37 times the same period last year.

Canon's revenue for the first half of 2026 was 57.92 billion yuan, with a gross margin of 24.18%, down 4.41 percentage points from the same period last year. The company's net profit for the first half of 2026 was 5.11 billion yuan, up 1.51 times from the same period last year, with an EPS of 1.55 yuan.

Canon noted that it has been actively deepening its AI strategy cooperation in recent times, investing in 'Canon Smart' and combining the technology capabilities of Linker Vision in AI visual recognition, generative AI, and city-level AI monitoring platforms. Through the NVIDIA AI ecosystem and Metropolis platform established by NVIDIA (NVDA-US), the company aims to form a one-stop intelligent city solution that integrates high-level optical imaging, AI visual analysis, edge computing, and city management platforms, which will not only enhance the company's competitiveness in large government contracts and enterprise projects but also increase product added value.

Canon noted that AI vision will be a key core technology in the future trillion-dollar market, from intelligent cities to intelligent factories, and extending to humanoid robots and service robots. In addition to continuously laying out AI intelligent cities, Canon has also invested in robot startups through its group investment strategy, focusing on Mantis Robotics, Agility Robotics, and Japanese humanoid robots, and aims to seize the next wave of AI robot industry growth opportunities by combining the group's resources in optics, AI algorithms, visual sensing, and intelligent manufacturing.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, with the global AI computing demand continuing to rise, intelligent city construction accelerating, and the robot industry formally entering the commercialization stage, Canon will continue to benefit from the increasing penetration rate of AI image applications, higher-end product ratios, and strategic cooperation benefits, bringing new growth momentum to future operations and profits.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉四寶7月營收年月雙增同樂  南亞受惠AI貢獻創49個月來新高
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Group's Four Major Businesses Achieve Double-Digit Growth in July
paras: 台塑 (1301-TW) 集團四寶今 (7) 日公告 7 月營收及未來展望，受惠美伊地緣衝突帶動油價及石化原料上揚，加上旺季支援，營收均呈現年月雙增，南亞 (1303-TW)、台化 (1326-TW)、台塑化 (6505-TW) 年增更超過 3 成以上。南亞更因北美雲端業者 (CSP) 全力打造資料中心，售價調漲挹注，營收創近 49 個月以來新高。
台塑 7 月營收為 152.94 億元、月增 9.4％、年增 4.8％，今 (2026) 年前 7 月累計營收為 1,045.33 億元、年減 2.5%。台塑表示，7 月因乙烯供應量比 6 月增加，加上開工率提高，及美伊衝突再起，下游客戶預期石化產品價格上漲，購買意願回升，主要產品銷量較 6 月增加 7.8 萬噸。
南亞 7 月營收為 305.73 億元、月增 12.7％、年增更達 44.5％，前 7 月累計營收為 1,828.16 億元、年增 19.9％。
南亞在四大產業成長貢獻之下，單月營收攀升至 49 個月新高，在電子材料產品的核心動能推升下，營收占比再提升至 57%，隨北美 CSP 業者全力打造資料中心，擴充伺服器，再加上中系業者也積極佈署算力建設，使相關材料供需缺口再放大，南亞依市況調漲電子材料售價、提高產能利用率至 9 成以上，讓營收貢獻提高。

台塑化烯烴事業營業額則比 6 月增加 29.7%，主因為乙烯產品售量增加，且售電價與售電量均月增，也帶動公用事業營業額比上月增加 15％。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Group (1301-TW) announced its July revenue and future outlook on July 7, benefiting from the surge in oil prices and petrochemical raw materials due to the US-Iran geopolitical tensions, as well as the peak season support, with revenue showing year-over-year and month-over-month growth. The company's revenue share from electronic materials products increased to 57%, driven by the core driving force of electronic materials products. The company also benefited from the expansion of data centers by North American CSP companies, which increased demand for related materials, leading to a shortage and higher prices. South Asia adjusted its electronic materials prices and increased its production capacity utilization rate to over 90%, contributing to revenue growth.

In addition, South Asia's consumer-grade general-purpose materials continued to grow, with chemical products benefiting from the replenishment of inventory for EG and BPA, and plastic products benefiting from the recovery of demand for automotive and footwear materials, leading to increased sales and revenue.

Formosa Chemicals & Fibre's July revenue reached NT$312.67 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 13% and a year-over-year increase of 34.2%. The company also adjusted its product mix to increase the proportion of differentiated products and raise average prices.

Formosa Plastics Petrochemical's July revenue reached NT$748.21 billion, with a month-over-month increase of 17.5% and a year-over-year increase of 31.5%. items.title: 德銀看好美光SCA轉型！AI讓記憶體價值占比飆至50% 獲利有上修空間
items.title_en: Deutsche Bank Looks Favorably on Micron's SCA Transformation, AI Boosts Memory Value to 50%
paras: 記憶體股一片低氣壓中，美光 (MU-US) 周四 (5 日) 盤中一度翻紅上揚，雖然最終不敵賣壓收黑，但分析師對美光正在推動的轉型給予高度評價。
美光午盤一度翻紅，終場仍下跌 1.3% 至每股 881.47 美元。其他記憶體股跌幅較重，同樣生產 NAND 快閃記憶體的 Sandisk(SNDK-US)因周三盤後公布的財測不如分析師預期，股價收低 6.8%，SK 海力士 ADR(SKHY-US)跌約 5%，儲存裝置大廠威騰電子 (WDC-US) 因財報不如預期暴跌 13%。
市場雖然對 Sandisk 本季財測低於預期感到失望，但多位華爾街分析師認為，公司透過新的長期供貨協議商業模式，將有助於未來幾年獲利持續成長。

AI 時代 記憶體重要性大增

美光目前也正推動類似轉型，並獲得分析師高度評價。該公司今年 3 月推出名為「策略性客戶協議」(Strategic Customer Agreements, SCA) 的長期供貨模式，可提升需求能見度，同時讓客戶更有把握取得供貨。
德意志銀行 (Deutsche Bank) 分析師 Melissa Weathers 指出，美光「持續演進的商業模式」正是該公司在記憶體市場保持領先的重要原因。
目前 NAND 快閃記憶體與 DRAM 供給依然吃緊，而 AI 需求讓供需失衡的程度比以往景氣循環更嚴重。
Weathers 引述美光管理層說法指出，在供給吃緊環境下，客戶通常會優先確保核心記憶體容量，而非儲存裝置，因為後者仍可透過外接模組擴充，因此記憶體系統的需求彈性更低。
Weathers 表示，根據美光高層提供的訊息，SCA 目的在於降低整體產業供給短缺造成的劇烈波動，預估將涵蓋約 40% 的記憶體出貨量。此外，美光從高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 到儲存產品擁有完整產品線，使其「得以兼顧成長與獲利」。
Weathers 還認為，市場低估了 AI 時代記憶體在整體系統價值中的重要性：在 AI 興起之前，記憶體約占系統價值 10%，如今已接近 50%。在產品競爭力、新供貨協議以及供需持續吃緊等因素帶動下，她認為美光未來獲利預估仍有上修空間。
paras_en: Despite the downturn in memory stocks, Micron (MU-US) briefly turned positive on Thursday (5th) before ultimately succumbing to selling pressure and closing lower. However, analysts have given high praise to the transformation that Micron is driving.

Micron's stock briefly turned positive during mid-day trading but ultimately closed 1.3% lower at $881.47 per share. Other memory stocks fell more sharply, with Sandisk (SNDK-US), which also produces NAND flash memory, closing 6.8% lower after releasing a disappointing earnings forecast after the market closed on Wednesday. SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell approximately 5%, and storage device manufacturer Western Digital (WDC-US) plummeted 13% due to a disappointing earnings report.

Although the market was disappointed by Sandisk's lower-than-expected earnings forecast, several Wall Street analysts believe that the company's new long-term supply agreement business model will help drive sustained profit growth over the next few years.

In the AI era, the importance of memory has increased significantly. Micron is also undergoing a similar transformation and has received high praise from analysts. In March, the company launched a long-term supply model called 'Strategic Customer Agreements' (SCA), which can improve demand visibility and give customers more confidence in their supply chain.
Deutsche Bank analyst Melissa Weathers pointed out that Micron's 'evolving business model' is a key reason why the company remains a leader in the memory market.
Currently, the supply of NAND flash memory and DRAM remains tight, and AI demand has exacerbated the supply and demand imbalance to a greater extent than in previous economic cycles.

Weathers cited Micron's management as saying that in a tight supply environment, customers typically prioritize core memory capacity over storage devices, which can still be expanded through external modules, making memory systems less elastic in demand.

Weathers stated that according to information provided by Micron's management, the purpose of SCA is to reduce the severe fluctuations caused by industry-wide supply shortages, which is expected to cover around 40% of memory shipments. Additionally, Micron's comprehensive product line, from high-bandwidth memory (HBM) to storage products, enables the company to 'balance growth and profitability'.

Weathers also believes that the market has underestimated the importance of memory in the overall system value in the AI era: before the rise of AI, memory accounted for around 10% of system value, but now it is close to 50%. Driven by factors such as product competitiveness, new supply agreements, and ongoing tight supply and demand, she believes that Micron's future earnings estimates still have room for upward revision.

items.title: 美零售商折價出售關稅退稅權 以確保先拿到現金
items.title_en: US Retailers Discount Tax Refund Rights to Ensure Cash Flow
paras: 在美國最高法院裁定部分關稅違法後，許多企業原本可領回巨額退款，但因政府核發程序緩慢且充滿不確定性，業者面臨現金流壓力，正採取一種非典型的融資策略，寧願大幅折扣將未來的關稅退稅權出售給第三方買家，以換取即時的現金流注入。
根據《華爾街日報》與《Retail Dive》報導，包括 GoPro、American Eagle Outfitters 以及 The Children’s Place 在內的多家企業，已陸續與買家達成協議，轉讓價值數百萬美元的關稅退稅債權。
其中，American Eagle Outfitters 的做法最具代表性，該公司在其 2026 年第一季報告中透露，已將價值 6,890 萬美元的關稅退稅債權，以 1,860 萬美元的價格折價出售，換取現金流入。
另一家零售商 The Children’s Place 表示，公司支付了約 4,000 萬美元的關稅，並已同意將其中 3,820 萬美元的退稅債權轉讓給 Alnus Investors，換取 2,570 萬美元的資金。運動用品商 Academy Sports & Outdoors 同樣出售了部分債權以獲取約 1,050 萬美元，並保留部分向政府申請退稅的權利。
這股趨勢背後的主要原因，在於聯邦政府退稅進度緩慢。儘管美國最高法院於 2026 年 2 月裁定川普依據《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA) 徵收的關稅違法，但向美國海關及邊境保衛局 (CBP) 申請退稅的過程極其艱辛且漫長。 截至 7 月底，政府已退還約 1,000 億美元關稅，僅占總徵收額 1,660 億美元的 60%。
財務諮詢公司 BDO 的執行董事 David Wong 指出，這類交易對賣方而言最大的風險在於時間的不確定性。企業必須在「等待更長時間以獲得全額退稅」與「立即獲得較少資金」之間做出權衡。對於急需現金緩衝的零售商來說，即使損失部分潛在金額，現金融資帶來的靈活性仍具吸引力。
與此同時，貿易爭議仍未平息。雖然先前的關稅被裁定違法，但川普仍試圖透過 1974 年《貿易法》重啟關稅政策，目前已引發至少 25 個州政府與多個小企業團體提起訴訟。
paras_en: After the US Supreme Court ruled that some tariffs were illegal, many companies that could have received large refunds faced cash flow pressure due to the slow and uncertain government reimbursement process. To address this, they are adopting an unconventional financing strategy, opting to significantly discount their future tax refund rights to third-party buyers in exchange for immediate cash injections.

According to reports by The Wall Street Journal and Retail Dive, several companies, including GoPro, American Eagle Outfitters, and The Children's Place, have reached agreements with buyers to transfer tax refund rights valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

American Eagle Outfitters' approach is particularly representative, as the company disclosed in its first-quarter 2026 report that it had sold tax refund rights valued at $689 million for $186 million, securing cash inflow.

Another retailer, The Children's Place, stated that it paid approximately $400 million in tariffs and agreed to transfer $382 million in refund rights to Alnus Investors in exchange for $257 million in capital. Academy Sports & Outdoors, a sporting goods retailer, also sold part of its rights to obtain approximately $105 million and retained the right to apply for refunds from the government.

The underlying reason for this trend is the slow pace of federal refunds. Although the US Supreme Court ruled in February 2026 that tariffs imposed by Trump under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were illegal, the process of applying for refunds from US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is extremely difficult and lengthy. As of July 31, the government had returned approximately $100 billion in tariffs, accounting for only 60% of the total $166 billion collected.

David Wong, an executive director at financial consulting firm BDO, noted that the main risk for sellers in these transactions is the uncertainty of time. Companies must weigh the option of waiting longer to receive full refunds against receiving less capital immediately. For retailers that urgently need cash buffers, the flexibility provided by immediate financing is attractive, even if it means losing some potential value.

Meanwhile, trade disputes remain unresolved. Although the previous tariffs were ruled illegal, Trump is attempting to revive tariff policies under the 1974 Trade Act, which has led to at least 25 state governments and multiple small business groups filing lawsuits.

items.title: 史上最缺一年將至？記憶體三巨頭把2027產能賣光 消息人士：一些AI公司已在「跪求晶片」
items.title_en: DRAM Shortage to Worsen in 2027 as Memory Giants Sell Out
paras: 隨著 AI 資本開支狂飆，全球 DRAM/HBM 產能遭提前掃貨。多家媒體彙整供應鏈消息指出，三星、SK 海力士、美光已經完成 2027 全年產能分配談判，DRAM 與 HBM 產線「提前售罄」，多數客戶最終配貨僅拿到一開始請求的 60%-70%，三家均無新增產線規劃，NAND 則因供應商較多，買方尚有零星談判空間，但整體仍緊俏。
夏季本是採購未來一年零組件旺季，今年卻上演「全年產能歸零」戲碼，凸顯 AI 伺服器、GPU 叢集與端側 Agent 對記憶體的吞噬速度。
SK 集團會長崔泰源近期直言，2027 年 AI 半導體需求較今年增加 60%-100%、整體記憶體需求增 50%-60%，「將是史上最嚴峻短缺與供需失衡」。
資深業內人士判斷，2026 年缺口已現，明年將從缺口擴大成結構性斷層。
溢價搶料已經開始。部分 AI 新創公司「跪求」最後批次，願付高於合約價換優先出貨，但晶圓物理極限卡死供給曲線。
與此同時，成本傳導鏈清晰；記憶體漲價→主機漲價→手機漲價。微軟本週調升 Xbox Series X/S 最高 150 美元，任天堂打算 9 月起調高 Switch 2 美國售價，離蘋果 iPhone 18 Pro 發表僅剩幾周，1399 美元起售價幾乎成市場共識，DRAM 斷料還可能拖累首銷現貨。
當「硬體老化降價」規律被記憶體超級週期推翻，消費電子正集體進入「越賣越貴」的新定價時代，而 2027 年才是壓力頂峰。
paras_en: Global DRAM and HBM production capacity has been depleted ahead of schedule, with Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron completing their 2027 annual production allocation negotiations. DRAM and HBM production lines have been sold out, with most customers receiving only 60-70% of their initial orders. The three companies have no plans to add new production lines, while NAND production has more suppliers, leaving some room for negotiation, but the overall market remains tight.

The summer season is typically a peak time for purchasing components for the next year, but this year has seen a 'zero production capacity' scenario, highlighting the rapid consumption of memory by AI servers, GPU clusters, and edge agents.

SK Group Chairman Choi Tae-won recently stated that AI semiconductor demand in 2027 will increase by 60-100% compared to this year, with overall memory demand increasing by 50-60%. He described it as 'the most severe shortage and supply imbalance in history'.
Industry insiders believe that the shortage has already begun in 2026 and will worsen in 2027, becoming a structural gap.

Price gouging has already started, with some AI startups 'kneeling' to request the last batch, willing to pay more than the contract price for priority delivery, but the physical limits of silicon are capping the supply curve.

Meanwhile, the cost transmission chain is clear: memory price increases → mainboard price increases → smartphone price increases. Microsoft has raised the price of Xbox Series X/S by up to $150 this week, while Nintendo plans to increase the price of Switch 2 in the US from September. The price of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro, which is set to be released in a few weeks, is expected to start at $1,399, almost a market consensus, and DRAM shortages may further delay the availability of new products.

As the 'hardware aging and price reduction' rule is being overturned by the memory supercycle, the consumer electronics industry is entering a new pricing era where 'the more you sell, the more expensive it gets', and 2027 is expected to be the peak of the pressure.

items.title: 供應吃緊！傳輝達擬下調Rubin Ultra HBM記憶體配置
paras: 《The Information》6 日報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 正評估一項頗為激進的調整方案——為下一代 AI GPU Rubin Ultra 推出 HBM 記憶體配置低於原先規劃的版本，以緩解高階 HBM 供應不足帶來的量產壓力。
知情人士透露，過去數週輝達已測試至少三個不同版本的 Rubin Ultra GPU，其中部分版本採用了低於最初規劃的 HBM 記憶體容量。輝達考慮推出低 HBM 記憶體配置版本，核心原因在於未來可能無法取得足夠數量的高階 HBM 晶片，以支撐原始設計的大規模量產。報導發布後，週四輝達股價收跌 0.1%，SK 海力士股價收跌 4.97%。

HBM 為何成為 AI 產業鏈「最硬瓶頸」

根據 TrendForce 集邦科技最新記憶體產業研究，DRAM 供不應求格局將延續至 2027 年。HBM 位元出貨量預計於 2027 年年增 50% 至 60%，但仍不足以滿足需求成長。
HBM 供應緊張源於兩大結構性瓶頸：
瓶頸一：整體 DRAM 產能受限。 2027 年整體 DRAM 供應仍維持緊缺，將限制原廠可分配給 HBM 的晶圓產能。SK 海力士公開表示 HBM、DRAM 及 NAND 產能於 2026 年已全部售罄；三星於 4 月財報中警告記憶體短缺將持續至 2027 年；美光執行長則表示，中期內僅能滿足關鍵客戶 50% 至三分之二的需求。
瓶頸二：HBM4e 12hi 驗證與良率仍存在不確定性。 HBM4e 12hi 的驗證時程與量產良率提升進度仍存在不確定性。HBM 製程複雜、良率要求高、擴產週期長，供應成長速度始終難以追上 AI 需求。
輝達自 2025 年至 2026 年上半年期間，持續以 HBM4e 12hi 作為 Rubin Ultra 的基準設計，直到 2026 年第三季才開始評估其他較低規格方案。
若最終決定調降 HBM 規格，預估將優先從調整堆疊層數著手。TrendForce 指出，輝達在 Rubin Ultra 世代的首要目標是提升 I/O 速度，而擴大 GPU 出貨量則屬於次要優先事項。

潛在影響：三層傳導機制

對輝達：出貨量 vs. 單晶片性能的權衡
HBM 記憶體容量縮減將影響晶片性能，但輝達可透過其他技術手段進行部分補償。具體而言：
I/O 速度降級： 若 HBM4e 如期完成驗證，Rubin Ultra 的 I/O 速度可由上一代 Rubin 的 8 至 11.7Gbps 提升至 14 至 16Gbps；若被迫改採 HBM4 低配方案，速度增幅可能僅維持在 11 至 12Gbps。
出貨量優先策略： 犧牲單顆 GPU 搭載的 HBM 記憶體容量，以換取更大的出貨規模，本質上是在「量」與「質」之間做取捨。
對輝達而言，此項調整的正面意義在於，可確保 Rubin Ultra 按計畫上市，而非繼續等待供應鏈擴產；負面影響則是產品競爭力可能較原規劃有所削弱。
對雲端業者：更多 GPU、更高成本
若 Rubin Ultra 最終採用較低 HBM 記憶體配置，在執行大型語言模型等 AI 工作負載時，客戶可能需要部署更多 GPU，才能完成原本由較少晶片即可完成的運算。
對微軟、Meta、亞馬遜、Google 等持續擴大 AI 資本支出的大型雲端業者而言，這意味著未來資料中心建設成本可能進一步攀升。HBM 價格上漲帶來的影響已不僅限於 AI 伺服器，而是推升整個科技產業的硬體成本。
對 HBM 供應商：定價權仍掌握在供應端
從供需角度來看，TrendForce 預估 2027 年 HBM 議價權仍偏向供應商，HBM 單位價格持續大幅上漲已成為市場共識。AI 晶片廠商將面臨 HBM 供給緊縮與採購成本提高的雙重壓力，因此採用較低容量 HBM 的動機將進一步增強。
DRAM 合約價預計於 2026 年第三季上漲 13% 至 18%，HBM 供應商在 2027 年前仍將持續掌握定價權。

市場與客戶看法分歧

報導指出，多家客戶對此調整的市場影響持相對平靜態度。兩家輝達客戶表示，即使 HBM 配置下調，預計也不會明顯削弱 Rubin Ultra GPU 的市場需求。
另有客戶表示，相較於單顆 GPU 搭載的 HBM 記憶體規格，其更看重與輝達維持長期合作關係。若產品售價同步調降，低 HBM 記憶體版本反而可能成為希望控制成本企業更具性價比的選擇。
輝達股價跌幅有限，反映市場對此消息抱持複雜解讀——一方面擔憂產品競爭力可能削弱，另一方面也肯定其「保出貨、保上市」策略。

投資分析

第一，主動調整優於被動斷供。
在產品規格與供應能力之間主動尋求平衡，雖然犧牲了部分性能上限，但可確保產品按時上市並順利量產。對輝達而言，「有貨可賣」比「規格完美卻缺貨」更具商業價值。
第二，客戶黏著度極高。
客戶更重視與輝達的長期合作關係，而非單顆 GPU 的 HBM 記憶體規格。只要 CUDA 生態系護城河仍在，客戶就不太可能因 HBM 容量減少而轉向競爭對手。
第三，價格彈性可部分抵銷性能損失。
若低 HBM 記憶體配置版本同步調降售價，反而可能擴大市場覆蓋率。對於推論等 HBM 需求較低的 AI 工作負載，低配版可能更具成本效益。
第四，這本質上是整個產業的供給限制，而非輝達的競爭劣勢。
所有 AI 晶片廠商都面臨相同的 HBM 供應短缺，部分 AI ASIC 業者也開始評估採用容量較低的 HBM 方案。輝達的應變速度與執行能力，仍是產業標竿。
三項值得留意的訊號
第一，「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」正成為 AI 擴張的重要限制。
即使是產業鏈中議價能力最強的輝達，產品規劃仍受到 HBM 供應限制。這也凸顯整個 AI 產業鏈的脆弱性——算力需求持續攀升，但 HBM 供給卻受限於擴產速度。
第二，產品差異化可能縮小。
若 Rubin Ultra 的 I/O 速度由 14 至 16Gbps 降至 11 至 12Gbps，與競爭對手的差距可能縮小。雖然短期內仍不足以撼動輝達的市場領導地位，但長期而言，產品競爭力下降的累積效應仍值得關注。
第三，HBM 供應商的成長預期可能受到影響。
若輝達大規模採用低 HBM 配置方案，HBM 位元需求可能低於市場原先預期，進而影響 SK 海力士、三星及美光等供應商的長期成長預期。
與大摩報告相互印證
這起事件，也與摩根士丹利 Shawn Kim 近期發布的《Memory – A Small Wrinkle》報告形成高度呼應。
「變化速率觸頂」正在發生。輝達評估調降 HBM 規格，本質上反映 HBM 價格漲幅與供應吃緊程度，已逐漸逼近產業鏈可承受的極限。
「但週期遠未結束」同樣成立。輝達仍全力推進 Rubin Ultra 量產，代表 AI 需求依舊強勁，只是供給端瓶頸迫使整個產業鏈做出妥協。
「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」正逐漸成為 AI 發展的核心瓶頸。大摩指出，「記憶體正日益成為 AI 建設的瓶頸，甚至可能成為唯一的瓶頸。」如今，輝達的實際行動，也進一步印證了這項判斷。

總結與展望

輝達評估下調 Rubin Ultra 的 HBM 記憶體配置，可說是 AI 產業「記憶體牆（Memory Wall）」由理論走向現實的重要象徵。
事件背後的核心矛盾在於：AI 算力需求持續快速擴張，但 HBM 供給仍受限於實體產能擴充速度。輝達選擇犧牲部分單晶片性能，以換取更大的出貨規模，是一種務實的「次佳解」，既反映供應鏈的現實限制，也展現管理層在有限資源下追求商業利益最大化的策略。
從投資角度來看，此事件對輝達的影響偏向短期中性偏空、長期有限：

短期而言，產品規格調降可能引發市場對產品競爭力的疑慮。
中期而言，「保出貨」策略有助於維持營收成長的可預期性。
長期而言，只要 AI 需求趨勢不變，輝達的市場領導地位不太可能因一次 HBM 調整而受到根本影響。


至於 HBM 供應商（SK 海力士、三星、美光），此消息則偏向利空。若輝達未來大規模採用低 HBM 配置方案，HBM 位元需求可能低於原先預期。不過，TrendForce 仍預估 2027 年 HBM 議價權將持續偏向供應商，整體供需緊張格局並未改變。
後續值得觀察的重點包括：

輝達最終將採用哪一種 HBM 方案。
Rubin Ultra 是否能依照原定時程量產。
雲端服務供應商對新規格產品的實際採購反應。


這三項因素，將決定這道「小褶皺」是否只是 AI 產業發展中的短期波折，或將進一步演變為更深層的結構性變化。

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro漲價+缺貨雙重夾擊！A20 Pro良率高卻卡在DRAM 華爾街：新機1399美元起跳
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Faces Double Whammy: Price Hike and Shortage
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，距離 iPhone 18 系列發表倒數幾周，蘋果新機正面臨「成本暴衝＋DRAM 斷料」雙重夾擊，漲價幾成定局，首發缺貨亦難避免。
美國科技媒體《9to5mac》引述供應鏈與機構測算指出，漲價底氣來自三項硬體成本。一是全球 DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體持續緊缺、記憶體現貨價格暴漲；二是全新可變光圈主鏡頭成本較上一代增加 50%；三是首發台積電 2 奈米 A20 Pro 晶片搭配 WMCM 封裝，先進製程費用大幅墊高。
根據華爾街測算，為守住基本毛利，新機最低定價需 1299 美元，若計入影像溢價，蘋果很可能把 Pro 起售價鎖在 1399 美元，較此前同款漲價 300 美元；Pro Max 同步上調。
《彭博資訊》此前報導亦稱 Pro 漲幅介於 100 至 200 美元，僅摩根大通認為可透過零件優化對沖部分壓力。以 1299 美元試算，機型毛利率將從上代 47% 降至 44%，支撐 1399 美元站位。
產能端更棘手。A20 Pro 晶圓良率穩定、台積電產線正常，但專用 DRAM 供貨缺口巨大，已產出晶片無法完成 WMCM 整合封裝，台積電超 10 億美元等級的蘋果處理器產能被迫空轉。
供應鏈預判，iPhone 18 首發初期能保基礎鋪貨，但線上等待期拉長、線下門市現貨快速見底。
雪上加霜的是產品線收縮：今秋取消標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone Air 2(延至 2027 初)，僅留 iPhone Ultra 與 18 Pro 系列，入門款需求全數灌向 Pro，供需矛盾被進一步放大。
對消費者而言，新一代 Pro 不是「買不買得起」的單選，而是「付 1399 美元還要等多久」的雙重考驗。
對蘋果來說，DRAM 漲價潮正把硬體定價權從品牌溢價，部分交還給記憶體廠。
paras_en: A few weeks before the release of the iPhone 18 series, Apple's new machine is facing a double whammy of 'cost explosion + DRAM shortage', with a price hike almost certain and initial shortages unavoidable.

According to a report by US tech media 9to5mac, citing supply chain and institutional estimates, the price hike is driven by three hardware costs. Firstly, the global shortage of DRAM and NAND flash memory has led to a sharp increase in memory prices. Secondly, the new variable aperture main camera costs 50% more than the previous generation. Thirdly, the use of TSMC's 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip with WMCM packaging has significantly increased the cost of the advanced process.

According to Wall Street estimates, to maintain a basic profit margin, the new machine's minimum price would need to be $1,299. If image premium is factored in, Apple is likely to set the Pro starting price at $1,399, a $300 increase from the previous generation, with Pro Max following suit.

A previous report by Bloomberg Information also estimated that the Pro price hike would be between $100 and $200. However, Morgan Stanley believes that component optimization could help offset some of the pressure. At $1,299, the machine's profit margin would drop from 47% to 44%, supporting a $1,399 price point.

The production end is even more complicated. The A20 Pro chip has a stable yield rate, and TSMC's production lines are normal, but the shortage of specialized DRAM is massive. The produced chips cannot be completed with WMCM integration packaging, and TSMC's Apple processor production capacity has been forced to idle, with losses exceeding $1 billion.

Supply chain predictions indicate that the initial shipment of iPhone 18 will be able to meet basic demand, but online waiting periods will be extended, and offline store inventory will quickly dwindle.

Adding to the woes is the product line contraction: the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 (delayed to early 2027) will be canceled, leaving only the iPhone Ultra and 18 Pro series. The entry-level demand will be fully shifted to Pro, further exacerbating the supply-demand contradiction.
For consumers, the new Pro series is not a 'can't afford it' option, but a 'can I afford it and wait for how long' double test.
For Apple, the DRAM price surge is taking away the company's hardware pricing power, partly returning it to memory manufacturers.

items.title: AI資料中心需求升溫，Microchip財測優於預期，盤後股價漲7%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Demand Heats Up, Microchip Forecast Beats Expectations, After-Hours Stock Rises 7%
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Microchip Technology(MCHP-US)公布2027會計年度第一季財報，受惠於AI資料中心、工業、汽車及航太市場需求回升，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，並發布優於華爾街預估的第二季財測，激勵盤後股價上漲7%。
公司預估2027會計年度第二季營收將落在15.9億至16.2億美元，高於彙整分析師預估的15.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘預估為0.91至0.95美元，也優於市場預估的0.79美元。
Microchip表示，AI資料中心對晶片需求持續增溫，加上工業與汽車市場景氣循環回升，以及地緣政治因素帶動航太與國防支出成長，共同支撐業績表現。
2027會計年度第一季營收為14.9億美元，高於市場預估的14.6億美元；調整後每股盈餘為0.76美元，也優於市場預估的0.69美元。

items.title: 輝達終結連五紅 財報將成下一個催化劑
items.title_en: Nvidia Ends Five-Day Rally, Earnings Report to Be Next Catalyst
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 周四 (6 日) 一度延續漲勢，但最終未能守住盤中漲幅。市場認為，其將於本月稍晚公布的財報，可能成為推動股價進一步走高的關鍵催化劑。
輝達終場下跌 0.1%，收在 218.99 美元，終結連續五個交易日上漲。當天一度漲至 223.63 美元，隨後回吐全部漲幅。
輝達也是周四標普 500 指數成交量最大個股，以及那斯達克 100 指數成交量第二大股票。
今年以來，輝達股價已上漲 17.3%，過去 12 個月累計漲幅達 21%。
市場可能持續看好輝達在 AI 晶片市場的主導地位。最新跡象之一就是馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 日前透露，SpaceX(SPACEX-US)未來將全面採用輝達的硬體產品。
除此之外，輝達在所謂的主權 AI(Sovereign AI) 領域也占壓倒性優勢。據 Counterpoint Research 周三公布數據，92% 的主權 AI 模型都是使用輝達晶片完成訓練。
輝達 2026 會計年度來自主權 AI 的營收已較去年同期成長逾三倍，突破 300 億美元，公司也寄望未來持續擴大這項業務。
Counterpoint Research 研究總監 Marc Einstein 表示，「隨著主權 AI 基礎設施持續擴張，輝達正於全球各地簽署多項數十億美元規模的合作案，希望掌握下一波 AI 浪潮，也就是 AI 推論以及建設主權 AI 工廠。」
市場下一個重要催化劑，預料將是 8 月 26 日公布的輝達財報。公司股價通常會在財報公布前表現強勢，但財報發布後往往回落，因此市場將觀察這次是否能打破這項走勢。
Susquehanna 分析師 Christopher Jacobson 在研究報告中寫道，「由於輝達股價自上次財報公布後仍處於下跌狀態，我們再次回到先前的觀察，也就是輝達在每季財報公布前的『季中』交易模式，尤其是財報公布前 2 至 3 周通常會出現一波漲勢。」
他補充表示，「我們注意到，目前正好進入這段財報前期間，而在過去八個季中，這段時間的股價表現一直相當強勁。」
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) extended its rally on Thursday, but ultimately failed to hold onto its intraday gains, according to a report by Barron's. The market believes that the company's upcoming earnings report, to be released later this month, could be the key catalyst to drive the stock price even higher.
Nvidia ended the day down 0.1%, closing at $218.99, marking the end of its five-day winning streak. The stock briefly touched $223.63 before reversing all its gains.
Nvidia was also the largest traded stock on the S&P 500 index and the second-largest traded stock on the Nasdaq 100 index on Thursday.
This year, Nvidia's stock has risen 17.3%, with a cumulative gain of 21% over the past 12 months.

The market may continue to be optimistic about Nvidia's dominance in the AI chip market. One of the latest signs is that Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX (SPACEX-US), recently revealed that the company will fully adopt Nvidia's hardware products in the future.

In addition, Nvidia has a significant lead in the so-called Sovereign AI domain. According to data released by Counterpoint Research on Wednesday, 92% of Sovereign AI models are trained using Nvidia chips.

Nvidia's revenue from Sovereign AI in its 2026 fiscal year has grown more than threefold compared to the same period last year, exceeding $30 billion. The company hopes to continue expanding this business in the future.

Marc Einstein, research director at Counterpoint Research, said, "As the Sovereign AI infrastructure continues to expand, Nvidia is signing multiple multi-billion-dollar deals around the world, hoping to capture the next wave of AI, which is AI inference and building Sovereign AI factories."

The next important catalyst for the market is expected to be Nvidia's earnings report on August 26. The company's stock typically performs strongly before the earnings report is released, but often falls after the report is published, so the market will be watching to see if this trend is broken.

Susquehanna analyst Christopher Jacobson wrote in a research report, "Given that Nvidia's stock price has remained in a downtrend since the last earnings report, we are once again returning to our previous observation, which is Nvidia's 'mid-quarter' trading pattern, especially the 2-3 weeks before the earnings report."
He added, "We note that we are currently in this pre-earnings period, and in the past eight mid-quarters, the stock price has performed extremely strongly."

items.title: 華爾街不信AI紅利能持久？SanDisk、美光估值跌至科技股谷底 6倍本益比引兩派論戰
items.title_en: Wall Street Questions AI Premium Sustainability: SanDisk, Micron Valuations Plummet to Tech Stock Lows
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 帶動高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 與企業級儲存需求爆發，記憶體廠商獲利預估持續上修，但市場給予的估值卻反而降至大型科技股最低水準。SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (Micron Technology) (MU-US) 目前前瞻本益比僅約 6 倍，引發市場討論，究竟是遭到低估，還是反映投資人擔憂記憶體景氣循環終將反轉。
根據市場資料，目前 SanDisk (SNDK-US)以 6.0 倍前瞻本益比，成為美國大型科技股中估值最低的公司；美光科技 (MU-US) 則以 6.3 倍居次。兩家公司今年股價分別累計大漲 444.4% 與 216.1%，但華爾街仍以接近景氣循環谷底企業的估值標準看待兩家公司。
相較之下，GoDaddy (GDDY-US)前瞻本益比為 8.6 倍，今年股價下跌 28.2%；超微電腦 (Super Micro Computer) (SMCI-US) 為 8.9 倍，仍較歷史高點低 75.4%；Adobe (ADBE-US)為 9.9 倍，今年跌 26.7%；Gartner (IT-US)則為 11.7 倍，距歷史高點仍有 68.8% 的差距。
資料來源：Koyfin
值得注意的是，兩家記憶體公司的低估值並非來自獲利預測遭下修，反而是在市場持續調高未來獲利預估的情況下形成。
市場目前預估，SanDisk (SNDK-US)未來 12 個月每股獲利 (EPS) 可達 214.32 美元，較 3 個月前約 168 美元大幅提高 27.6%，但股價仍較歷史高點回落約 46%。
美光科技 (MU-US) 情況亦相似，分析師目前預估未來 12 個月 EPS 將達 144.21 美元，較 3 個月前約 114 美元提高 26.7%，但股價仍較歷史高點低約 29%。
市場人士指出，這代表股價下跌速度遠高於獲利預期上修速度，因此使本益比快速壓縮。
不過，也有分析認為，記憶體向來是半導體產業中景氣循環最劇烈的領域之一，歷史經驗顯示，記憶體股往往正是在獲利接近高峰時，本益比最低。隨著供給逐漸增加、價格回落，企業獲利可能快速下降，屆時目前看似便宜的 6 倍本益比，很可能迅速升高。
然而，AI 是否改變產業循環，正成為市場最大爭論焦點。
在最新財報中，SanDisk (SNDK-US) 表示，公司推動多年期供貨合約與固定價格、保底價格的新商業模式，預估 2027 財年將涵蓋超過一半出貨位元 (bit)，2028 財年可提高至約三分之二，相關長約合計提供 165 億美元財務保障，藉此降低記憶體價格波動風險。
另一方面，美光科技 (MU-US) 近期亦表示，公司已與客戶簽署 16 項長期供貨協議，合約期限延伸至 2030 年。公司最新財測預估本季營收約為 500 億美元，前一季營收則為 414.6 億美元，顯示 AI 需求仍維持強勁。
近期包括美光、SK 海力士及三星電子等主要 HBM 供應商均表示，2026 年與 2027 年高頻寬記憶體產能大多已提前售罄，AI 伺服器持續帶動 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 需求，加上大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大 AI 資料中心投資，使市場開始重新評估記憶體產業是否已進入不同於過去的新景氣循環。
分析人士指出，若 AI 長期需求足以支撐記憶體價格與企業獲利維持高檔，目前約 6 倍的前瞻本益比將顯得相當便宜；反之，若 AI 需求最終仍回歸傳統半導體景氣循環，目前的低估值可能只是反映市場預期獲利接近高峰。
換言之，SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (MU-US) 如今已成為 AI 投資熱潮下最具代表性的估值觀察指標，市場真正關心的不只是 AI 需求是否持續成長，而是 AI 是否足以永久改變記憶體產業過去高度循環的商業模式。
paras_en: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has driven a surge in demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and enterprise storage, leading to profit estimates for memory manufacturers being consistently revised upwards. However, the market's valuation of these companies has plummeted to the lowest level among large tech stocks, sparking debate over whether they are undervalued or reflect investors' concerns about the cyclical nature of the memory industry.

According to market data, SanDisk (SNDK-US) currently has a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 6.0, making it the most undervalued company among US large-cap tech stocks, while Micron Technology (MU-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 6.3. Despite their stock prices increasing by 444.4% and 216.1% respectively this year, Wall Street views both companies as if they were at the bottom of the industry cycle.

In contrast, GoDaddy (GDDY-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.6, with a stock price decline of 28.2% this year; Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.9, still lower than its historical high by 75.4%; Adobe (ADBE-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 9.9, with a stock price decline of 26.7%; and Gartner (IT-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 11.7, still 68.8% below its historical high.
Data source: Koyfin
Notably, the low valuations of the two memory companies are not due to downward revisions in profit estimates, but rather the market's continued upward revisions in future earnings estimates.

The market currently estimates that SanDisk (SNDK-US) will achieve earnings per share (EPS) of $214.32 over the next 12 months, a 27.6% increase from the $168 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 46% from its historical high.

Micron Technology (MU-US) has a similar situation, with analysts estimating that the company will achieve EPS of $144.21 over the next 12 months, a 26.7% increase from the $114 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 29% from its historical high.
Market participants point out that this represents a significant compression of the forward P/E ratio, as the stock price decline has outpaced the upward revision in earnings estimates.

However, some analysts argue that the memory industry has historically been one of the most cyclical in the semiconductor industry, with memory stocks often experiencing a low P/E ratio when earnings are near their peak. As supply increases and prices fall, corporate earnings may rapidly decline, making the current 6x forward P/E ratio appear attractive.
However, the question of whether AI will change the industry's cyclical nature has become the biggest point of contention in the market.

In its latest earnings report, SanDisk (SNDK-US) stated that the company has been driving a new business model with multi-year supply contracts and fixed prices, with the goal of covering over half of its output by 2027 and increasing to approximately 3/4 by 2028. This is expected to provide $16.5 billion in financial protection and reduce the risk of memory price volatility.

On the other hand, Micron Technology (MU-US) has recently announced that it has signed 16 long-term supply agreements with customers, with contract terms extending to 2030. The company's latest earnings estimate is $50 billion in revenue for the current quarter and $41.46 billion for the previous quarter, indicating that AI demand remains strong.

Major HBM suppliers, including Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics, have recently stated that their 2026 and 2027 HBM production capacity is largely sold out, driven by AI server demand and large cloud service providers' continued investment in AI data centers. This has led the market to reassess whether the memory industry has entered a new cycle.

Analysts point out that if AI demand can sustainably support memory prices and corporate earnings at high levels, the current forward P/E ratio of approximately 6 would be considered undervalued. Conversely, if AI demand ultimately returns to traditional semiconductor industry cycles, the current low valuations may simply reflect market expectations of earnings near their peak.

In other words, SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) have become the most representative valuation benchmarks in the AI investment frenzy, with the market's true concern being whether AI can permanently change the memory industry's cyclical business model.

items.title: 日本塗料上修全年營收展望，但獲利預測維持不變下半年原料成本仍是壓力
items.title_en: Nippon Paint Holdings Raises Full-Year Revenue Forecast, Maintains Profit Forecast Unchanged Amid Pressure from Rising Raw Material Costs
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本塗料控股Nippon Paint Holdings(4612-JP)公布2026會計年度第二季財報，受惠銷量增加、產品組合改善及匯率有利，第二季營收與調整後營業利益雙雙創同期新高。公司也將全年營收預估從1.92兆日圓上修至2兆日圓，但全年營業利益仍維持2,830億日圓不變，主要是下半年成本壓力仍高。
公司表示，中東局勢推升原物料成本，下半年壓力可能比上半年更明顯。雖然日圓匯率有利，公司也計畫透過漲價與控制成本因應，但這些利多仍不足以抵銷成本增加，因此沒有同步調高全年獲利預估。
各地區來看，日本市場表現亮眼，建築、工業及汽車塗料需求成長，第二季營業利益年增率65%；中國房市雖然持續低迷，但靠成本控制，營業利益大致與去年同期持平。東南亞則維持強勁成長，中國以外亞洲市場第二季營業利益年增率53.1%。
此外，日本塗料將斥資約4,700萬歐元，買回2021年出售給Wuthelam Group的歐洲汽車塗料業務，預計2026年10月完成交易，進一步擴大全球汽車塗料布局。

paras_en: Nippon Paint Holdings (4612-JP) reported its second-quarter earnings for fiscal 2026, benefiting from increased sales, improved product mix, and favorable exchange rates. The company's second-quarter revenue and adjusted operating profit both reached new highs for the period.

The company stated that the Middle East situation has pushed up raw material costs, and the pressure may be more pronounced in the second half of the year. items.title: 美中元首秋季峰會醞釀中 經貿與外交檯面下角力
items.title_en: US-China Leaders' Autumn Summit in the Works, Intensifying Economic and Diplomatic Tensions
paras: 根據《彭博》來自上海的消息，中國國家主席習近平與美國總統川普正計畫舉行一場關鍵的元首峰會，雙方的高層官員已展開密集的會前準備與紅線磋商。近期，負責經濟事務的中國副總理何立峰已與美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 及貿易代表葛里爾 (Jamieson Greer) 進行視訊通話。
在通話中，美方重點關注稀土等關鍵礦產的供應流向以及中國對美農產品的採購；而北京方面則針對華盛頓對華實施的「經貿限制」表達了強烈不滿。
隨著大賽前的緊張氣氛升高，雙方再次展開經濟交鋒。北京本週利用其在無人機生產領域的優勢，反擊美方近期對中國科技產業的出口管制。
這種在重大會晤前互相「遞招」的模式早有先例。去年 10 月美中領導人在南韓會面前，川普政府曾擴大制裁黑名單企業，中方隨即限制了對智慧型手機與先進武器 (如戰鬥機、飛彈攔截器) 至關重要的稀土出口，這些物資對於當時正處於美伊戰爭中的美國而言極具戰略意義。
儘管博弈升溫，但雙方目前仍維持一定的克制。中國商務部在發布最新反制措施時，特別稱其報復行動「總體克制」，並敦促美方透過對話化解分歧。
與此同時，美方在台灣問題等敏感問題也表現得相對低調，一項價值 140 億美元的對台軍售案目前仍被凍結，顯示美方不願在峰會前夕過度激怒北京。
這場預計於今年秋季舉行的峰會，被視為維繫甚至延長雙方「休戰」狀態的關鍵。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: According to Bloomberg's sources in Shanghai, Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Trump are planning to hold a crucial summit, with high-level officials from both sides engaging in intensive pre-meeting preparations and red-line negotiations. Recently, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng, responsible for economic affairs, has held video calls with US Treasury Secretary and Trade Representative.

During the calls, the US side focused on the supply of critical minerals such as rare earths and China's purchases of US agricultural products, while Beijing expressed strong dissatisfaction with Washington's 'economic and trade restrictions'.
As pre-summit tensions rise, both sides have resumed economic sparring. This week, Beijing leveraged its advantage in drone production to counter recent US export controls on Chinese tech industries.

This pattern of mutual 'jabs' before major meetings has precedents. Last October, before the US-China leaders' meeting in South Korea, the Trump administration expanded its sanctions blacklist, and China responded by restricting rare earth exports crucial for smartphones and advanced weaponry, such as fighter jets and missile interceptors, which were strategically important for the US amid the US-Iran conflict.

Despite escalating tensions, both sides are currently exercising restraint. China's Ministry of Commerce described its retaliatory actions as 'overall restrained' when announcing its latest countermeasures, urging the US to resolve differences through dialogue.

Meanwhile, the US has also been relatively low-key on sensitive issues like Taiwan, with a $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan currently frozen, indicating a reluctance to provoke Beijing excessively before the summit.
This summit, expected to take place this autumn, is seen as crucial for maintaining or even extending the 'truce' between the two nations.
